reviewer: Independent Claude (Opus 5.5) review agent, separate from the extraction agent feng-19; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of feng-dna-fm-20261013: 447 records (126 results, 32 claims, 118 configurations, 118 evaluations, 25 protocols, 25 datasets, 3 sources). Re-downloaded and matched the SHA-256 of the article XML, Supplementary Data workbook, Supplementary Information PDF, gtex_hyena.py and README; a separate parser compared all 126 Table 1 and Table 4 values with 0 mismatches; 22 datasets checked against Supplementary Data 6 and 26 baseline-CNN claims against Supplementary Data 1 and 2; descriptive claims, two proxy relevance judgements and scope checked against the text. All records set to source_checked by review/signoff.py.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any result.
Figures were read only where a claim cites them (Supplementary Fig. 2); main-text Figures 2 to 4 were not checked value by value.
Corrections were applied by the extractor in extract/extract_feng.py as specified in the review; see review.md.
The use case's assessed_by links and the judgement pins are added at integration, after this receipt.
corrections: Supplementary Information source: 11 pages, Supplementary Table 8 and Supplementary Figures 1 and 2 are present; the false 'not in the PDF' limitation was replaced by the TAD token-position discrepancy, and the TAD claim cites Supplementary Fig. 2.
GTEx configurations: the two allele embeddings are averaged (Methods); Enformer uses its final hidden state mean-pooled over regions.
dbGaP removed from access text and judgement limitations; the source names only the GTEx Protected Data Access portal.
TAD dataset: 'human reference genome' instead of GRCh38.

Judgement limitations gained the authors' preliminary-indicators caveat, no held-out loci or genes, distal elements outside the 6 kb window and the 131 kb versus 196 kb long inputs; the tables-not-extracted claim lists Supplementary Tables 5 to 8 and Supplementary Fig. 1; DNABERT-2 and GROVER configurations carry checkpoint values.
